definitions.gloss: to recall, to remember, to recollect
definitions.explanation: To bring a memory back to mind. Focuses on the active process of retrieving a memory, rather than simply having memorized something.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I recalled things from the past.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{名前|なまえ}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない。
examples.notes: Potential negative: {思|おも}い{出|だ}せない

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}を{聞|き}くと、{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
examples.english: When I hear this song, I remember my student days.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (recall X). Compound verb: {思|おも}う + {出|だ}す.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or state. {思|おも}い{出|だ}している = 'is recalling' or 'has recalled.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{昔|むかし}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (recall the past)
・{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない (can't remember)
・ふと{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (suddenly remember)
・{思|おも}い{出|だ}すたびに (every time I remember)

CONTRAST WITH {覚|おぼ}える:
・{覚|おぼ}える: to memorize, to learn (putting into memory)
・{思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to recall (retrieving from memory)

RELATED NOUN: {思|おも}い{出|で} (memory, recollection)
